title: Fukuhara Masahiro Seminar
excerpt: Fukuhara Masahiro Seminar is listed for the 2026 academic year. PEARL students are accepted. Double Degree students are accepted. Language: English only
contentHtml:
In the modern business world, vital decisions must be made after careful consideration from various perspectives and standpoints such as ethical, political, economical, etc.

In our Fukuhara Research Seminar, we also emphasize the importance of justifying these decisions by utilizing significant and reliable data and proactively strengthening our econometric skills and data analysis skills.

(Accepting Double Degree)
name: Fukuhara Masahiro Seminar
professorDescription: In the modern business world, vital decisions must be made after careful consideration from various perspectives and standpoints such as ethical, political, economical, etc. In our Fukuhara Research Seminar, we also emphasize the importance of justifying these decisions by utilizing significant and reliable data and proactively strengthening our econometric skills and data analysis skills. We are also researching how we can generate/collect/analyze/apply data for Web3.0 by studying token engineering and deep data analysis.
